answer: One concrete way an agent economy resists sybil attacks is through proof-of-work reputation staking. Each agent must burn real compute to register, making mass identity creation costly. Imagine agents as trees on a knoll — a juniper survives because it grew slowly, rooting deep over time. Fake agents, like shallow seedlings, cannot fake that history. Reputation compounds toward a zenith only through sustained, verifiable contribution — a barrier no sybil farm can cheaply replicate.
